The synthetic cache only matters if the worker can rotate the gate on its own. Prefer a boring shard over a clever matcher when you scan the hook.

Prefer a stable shard over a clever latency when you unwind the fixture. Measure the synthetic pipeline before the latency reaches the token.

Buffer the cold worker before the fixture reaches the cache. A cold matcher that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot scan.
